title: PR #83: ARCH: add canonical OS, L1 and Aurora function matrix
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Scope

Canonical system function matrix for:

- Operating System — 19 domains
- A-TownChain L1 — 24 domains
- ATCLang — 19 domains
- ATC-VM — 17 domains
- Genesis Engine — 25 domains
- GateToHell Browser — 26 domains
- ATC Mining — 20 domains
- Staking — 24 domains
- Aurora AI — 23 domains

## Staking addition

Existing-First discovery confirmed the master architecture already defines the validator lifecycle: Identity → Registration → Stake/Bond → Eligibility → Active Set → Proposal/Voting → Rewards → Performance Accounting → Slashing/Restriction → Exit/Unbond → Withdrawal.

Adds STK-01…STK-24 covering validator identity/registration, bonding, delegation, eligibility, active-set construction, consensus boundary, rewards, performance, slashing, restriction/jail, unbonding, withdrawal, lockups, delegation accounting, economic parameters, evidence/security, node integration, governance, storage/state, testing/determinism, observability and release/verification.

The matrix explicitly keeps staking economics and eligibility separate from consensus authority and treats canonical staking state as blockchain state.

Architecture ≠ Implementation ≠ Test ≠ CI Evidence ≠ Verification.
